name: Metadata Remover AI Inspector
description: Hosted MCP server from metadataremoverai.com: fetches a public image or video URL (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, GIF, TIFF, MP4, MOV; up to 15 MB) and reports hidden metadata: GPS location, camera and lens, timestamps, software, C2PA Content Credentials and AI-generator signals. Read-only, no auth; does not modify or store files.
author: fazal-bhinder
